clusters.title: Linux is dropping a 45-year-old driver because LLMs won't stop "fixing" it
Wine 11.23 fixes some gaming bugs, boosts DirectX 12 compatibility, and adds Arm64 macOS support

xda.author: Simon Batt
xda.body:
Linux is dropping a 45-year-old driver because LLMs won't stop "fixing" it
Every so often, the Linux kernel will drop support for older tech. In an ideal world, maintainers could support every piece of hardware ever made forever, but if people are using energy and resources to ensure the drivers for a specific CPU that nobody uses anymore still work, it's a lot of effort poured into something with minimal gain.
